My army marched beneath his banner as I gave him a promise that the flora of the Void would take root in every realm and bloom, until there was nothing left to bloom upon.
Now you will watch as your world dies a quiet, tranquil death.|audio = VoidcoreWave50-1.ogg|'''Void Caster''' on Wave 50 ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Void Caster''' is the final boss of [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode, alongside with the [[Void Reaver]] at the final wave. It does not spawn in naturally, and can be only spawned when the [[Void Reaver]] reaches half of its health. It has extremely high amount of health, around half of the [[Void Reaver]]'s, and has [[No Target]] and [[Full Immunity|God]]. When the [[Void Reaver]] is killed, the '''Void Caster''' loses its shield. While vulnerable, it begins to revive the [[Void Reaver]] for a short period of time. Once revived, the '''Void Caster''' becomes invulnerable again. This process repeats itself until the '''Void Caster''' is defeated, where it revives the [[Void Reaver]] one last time with its ''Void's Deathwish'' ability active. The '''Void Caster''' has four abilities: #''Shield'', where it shields the [[Void Reaver]], briefly giving it [[Health Regen]], then sets its [[Shield Health]] to 40,000. #''Summon'', causing it to summons in a portal that lasts on the map for 16 seconds, with each set of spawns taking up 4 seconds of that duration. Each time, it will spawn 22 enemies, which can be the [[Mandragora]] with a 20% chance (2 max, 0.15 delay), [[Slow King]] with a 15% chance (1 max, 0.3 delay), [[Blighted]] with a 25% chance (10 max, 0.15 delay), [[Unknown Small]] with a 15% chance (3 max, 0.15 delay) and [[Elite Void Rusher]] with a 25% chance (6 max, 0.03 delay). #''Revive'', which happens when the [[Void Reaver]] dies. It will spend 12 seconds reviving the [[Void Reaver]] to 420,000 health, but it will also lose the [[No Target]] and [[Full Immunity|God]] attributes for the duration. Upon defeat, it instantly revives the [[Void Reaver]] to 240,000 health and activates its ''Void's Deathwish'' ability. #''Rage'', which is a rage mode ability triggered at 40% health. The '''Void Caster''' changes its appearance and reduce its speed to 1. ==Logbook Description== "''Before there was anything to call the Old World, the Void was already waiting in the dark. It cannot be considered a place or a creature, but something else entirely. It is a quiet hunger that lurks beneath the notice of every being, the presence that can be felt when nothing is around. The pale flora that blooms in a place where nothing exists is where it finds its peace. It is of one mind, though it wears a thousand faces. One could call it an incurable infection. ''The brothers feared it, and even Lord Exo and Two X, who feared so little, understood that there was no killing a thing without a body. For the first and final time, they drove it deep down into the foundations of the world, into a dark so total its song could never be heard again. There were a handful of witnesses to this event, but all knew that the Void was only contained, not gone. They all knew the difference, and never spoke of it again.'' ''Somewhere in time within the Void, a flower grew, blossoming with a vibrant hue of purple. It was beautiful. From it grew a vessel, and soon, it grew a voice. The child opened her eyes to find nothing but darkness, and smiled the widest smile. Looking down, she picked up a fallen petal from where she grew and crushed it within her palm. The falling dust, scattered through the empty wind, and suddenly flora began to grow. The child was not the Void. The child called it Mother. What she did know was that she was the Void Caster, the daughter of the Void.'' ''Once Lord Exo learned of her existence, he saw an opportunity. He did not trust her so much as he used her. When the war between him and Two X began, he unearthed the Void and offered a deal to the Void Caster. She would walk beside him as his prized General, and in return the flora of the Void would take root in every realm and bloom. She still intends to keep that promise.'' ''When Lord Exo was sealed away, Two X turned his attention to the Void itself, hunting it throughout the Nil Zone. So the Void slunk back into the depths from which it was sealed, and the Void Caster went to the one place Two X would never follow. Straight into the heart of the Void itself. Even he would not set foot there. Even though a God cannot be killed, there are things worse than death that the Void was patiently waiting to do.'' ''The Meta exists everywhere across the entire Nil Zone, but it was not until the Rift Walker fell and the realms began to destabilize that the seams gave. Holes formed that connected the two worlds, and through the thinnest of those tears the Void crept out once more. In the barrens of the Nil Zone, where there was once life, a single lone flower blossomed from the earth.'' ''To kill the Void Caster is to misunderstand what she is. The body may no longer exist, and her song may go quiet for a while. But deep within the dark, it will begin again. At best, all one can do is send her home to Mother."'' ==Appearance== The '''Void Caster''' has a black body, purple eyes, and purple hair. She wears a purple and black robe with flowers on it, a black shirt, purple pants with a purple high-low skirt that is really short, a purple belt, purple shoes, and black gloves. She has purple horns on her head that have dark purple vines circling them, 2 on each horn, and a halo floating above her head. She carries a staff and a spell book in her hands. Once she has entered her second phase, she starts wearing a hood, and six horns will come out of her torso. On the matchmaking render, her robe is light purple, a light purple shirt, and black strings holding the sides of her robe loosely close. Her torso horns are black with light purple tips that glow. Her face is obscured by her hair, which is purple, and by a cage mask (This is assumed, please change if wrong), similar to the Void Reaver's, but only on her face, which also seems to be extending to her shoulders from the right and left grilles. Her pants are also light purple now, and her skin is purple. ==Strategy== *Prioritize the '''Void Caster''' as soon as the [[Void Reaver]]'s health reaches 0. **Abilities like the [[Medic]]'s ''Ubercharge'', the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' and the [[Saboteur]]'s ''Aggressive Toxins'' are best used here. *When '''Void Caster''' dies, the [[Void Reaver]] will use its ''Void Deathwish'' ability where it sprints towards the base. It is advised that you use all of your abilities and move your towers to the back once '''Void Caster''' dies to avoid being killed by the [[Void Reaver]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.0.0Thumbnail.png|'''Void Caster''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} HardcoreCountdown23Hour.png|'''Void Caster''' on the game icon. VoidCasterRender.png|'''Void Caster''' on the former [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] matchmaking icon. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidCasterIconIG.png|'''Void Caster''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Caster''' is the first boss enemy that gets slower upon activating its second phase. *The '''Void Caster''' has the longest logbook description in the entire game, also having the only description with multiple paragraphs. *The '''Void Caster''' could be considered as the only [[Boss]] enemy not to naturally spawn in. **The [[Awakened Fallen King]] may be considered an enemy that does not naturally spawn into the [[Hidden Wave]], but it may also be considered the second phase of the [[Fallen King]], which does naturally spawn into [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *The '''Void Caster''' was planned to be a secondary boss for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode back in 2020, but was cut due to time and technical constraints.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qXsG3Lxnasg (1:22:57) **It is likely that '''Void Caster''' being cut is the reason why [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode initially had two [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reavers]] before [[v1.2.1]]. *The '''Void Caster''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The '''Void Caster's''' theme Vocatis Inanis, when translated from Latin to English, translates to "''Call of the void''", "''Called from the void''" or "''You call the void''". ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0]] **'''Void Caster''' added. *'''7 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0|v2.0.6]] **''Summon'' changed: ***No longer summons the [[Void Brute]], as it is been removed from the summon pool.
